newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Aug 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Aug 8.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The paper carries the full text of President Henri Konan Bedie's Independence Day address to the nation, in which he repeats a pledge to make Ivory Coast "a new industrialised country within a generation".
- The ruling PDCI-RDA party calls on its members to go to the airport on Monday to greet Senegal's President Abdou Diouf at the start of a state visit.

- Jean-Louis Sarbib, World Bank vice-president for Africa, said at a meeting with non-governmental organisations (NGOs) at Grand-Bassam that people should blame irresponsible governments rather than the Bank when tough reform measures are needed. The Bank is decentralising and trying to work more closely with the local population and NGOs, he added.

- Le Jour looks at seven possible candidates to replace the late Charles Bauza Donwahi as speaker of the National Assembly. It gives the best chance to Denis Bra Kanon, a deputy and businessman that it describes as "charismatic and ambitious". The assembly speaker is the constitutional interim successor to the head of state.
